scripts.name: Konbini question
scripts.angle: Open with the question. Show the konbini ritual. Keep the gym after the hook.

hook.target: 毎朝コンビニでこれを買う理由、知ってる？
hook.gloss: Do you know why I buy this at the konbini every morning?

lines.target: 朝5時。まだ電車も空いてる。
lines.gloss: 5 AM. Even the trains are still empty.
lines.shot: Train platform at dawn. Wide shot. Creator walks in.

lines.target: コンビニで、いつものやつ。
lines.shot: Konbini fridge door opens. Hand takes the can.

lines.target: ゼロシュガーで、カフェイン200mg。
lines.shot: Close-up of the can label. Japanese on-screen text.

lines.target: ジムの前に一本。いくぞ。
lines.gloss: One can before the gym. Let's go.
lines.shot: Gym entrance. Creator opens the can.

lines.target: 今日も一日がんばろう。
lines.gloss: Let's do our best today too.
lines.shot: Creator to camera. Smile. City pop rises.

scripts.name: First-train POV
scripts.angle: POV of the first train. The can is the morning switch.

hook.target: POV：始発で出勤する日の朝
hook.gloss: POV: the morning you take the first train to work

lines.target: 駅のホームで、まずこれ。
lines.gloss: On the platform, this comes first.
lines.shot: Train platform. POV hand holds the can.

lines.target: 自販機じゃなくて、コンビニ派。
lines.gloss: Not the vending machine. I'm a konbini person.
lines.shot: Walk past a vending machine. Cut to the konbini counter.

lines.target: 仕事前の5分で、スイッチが入る。
lines.gloss: Five minutes before work, and the switch flips on.
lines.shot: Office desk. Open the can. The laptop opens.

lines.target: ゼロシュガーだから、罪悪感なし。
今日も一日がんばろう。
lines.gloss: Let's do our best today too.
lines.shot: Creator nods at the camera. Lo-fi beat.

scripts.name: Honest review
scripts.angle: A short honest review. It builds trust with a new audience.

hook.target: コンビニ新作エナドリ、正直レビュー
hook.gloss: New konbini energy drink: an honest review

lines.target: まず見た目。缶のデザイン、かなり好き。
lines.gloss: First, the look. I really like the can design.
lines.shot: Can on the konbini counter. Slow turn.

lines.target: 味は柑橘系で、甘すぎない。
カフェイン200mg、ゼロシュガー。
トレーニング前に飲んでみた結果…
lines.gloss: I drank it before training. The result...
lines.shot: Gym. Quick cuts of one set.

creator_picks.why: Gym plus salaryman life. Closest to your identity. He already posts 'one can before the gym'.
Owns the 5 AM day-in-the-life format in Japan. Highest average views in the sample.
Largest reach in konbini reviews. Best fit for Variant C.
First-train POV specialist. Best fit for Variant B.
Energy drink comparisons. A trusted voice in this niche.

caption.target: 毎朝のコンビニ、いつものやつ。今日も一日がんばろう。
caption.gloss: Every morning at the konbini, the usual. Let's do our best today too.
